rules.trigger_en: Any design, implementation or review request
rules.trigger_zh: 任意设计、实现或评审请求
rules.require_en: Preserve explicit user instructions, approved design decisions and existing functional contracts; scope changes to the asked task.
rules.require_zh: 优先遵守用户明确要求、已确认设计决策与既有功能契约，仅修改请求涉及的范围。
rules.exception_en: A user-approved redesign may intentionally replace the affected visual direction; record which decisions changed.
rules.exception_zh: 用户授权的重设计可替换指定范围内的视觉方向，须记录改变了哪些决定。
rules.never_en: Never infer that a Skill style override outranks the user's approved choices.
rules.never_zh: 不得把 Skill 默认风格解释成高于用户已确认选择的指令。

rules.topic: Language vs product locale / 指令语言与产品语言
rules.trigger_en: An Agent reads English instructions or works on a localized UI
rules.trigger_zh: Agent 读取英文规范或实现本地化产品
rules.require_en: Keep replies and product copy in the user's or existing product locale; verify actual text, CJK wrapping and numbers.
rules.require_zh: 答复与产品文案遵循用户或现有产品语言，检查真实文字、中英文换行与数字格式。
rules.exception_en: Translate product copy only if the user requests localization or the product requirements require that locale.
rules.exception_zh: 仅在用户请求翻译或产品明确需要该语言时翻译界面文案。
rules.never_en: Never translate an existing UI to English solely because MauForma's entrypoint is English.
rules.never_zh: 不得仅因为 MauForma 入口是英文，就把已有中文界面擅自改成英文。

rules.trigger_zh: 需要读取专项规范的任何任务
rules.require_en: Load one primary relevant guide; add secondary guides only for specific identified needs. A reference table lists choices, not mandatory steps.
rules.require_zh: 先读取一份直接相关主文档，仅在发现具体问题时补充专项资料；路由表不是全量必读清单。
rules.exception_en: Complex implementation or a verified blocker can justify more than three guides when each addition is relevant.
rules.exception_zh: 复杂实现或已证实阻塞可按实际需要超过三份，但每份增加都应有明确用途。
rules.never_en: Never load the entire Skill reference library or every validator by default.
rules.never_zh: 不得默认加载整个 Skill 参考库或运行全部检查器。

rules.topic: Component dependency / 组件与安装权限
rules.require_en: Inspect and reuse the installed accessible library first; map required controls to real components and test states.
rules.require_zh: 先盘点并复用现有可访问组件库，将需要的控件映射到实际组件并验证各状态。
rules.exception_en: If none exists, a new compatible dependency may be installed only within the user's delegated implementation and dependency policy; otherwise use sound native controls or report the blocker.
rules.exception_zh: 没有合适库时，仅在实现授权和依赖策略允许范围内引入兼容依赖；否则优先合格原生控件或说明阻塞。
rules.never_en: Never silently install global tooling or replace real controls with click-only div elements.
rules.never_zh: 不得擅自安装全局工具，也不得用仅支持点击的 div 伪造 Select 等控件。

rules.topic: Optional visual effects / 可选视觉特效
rules.trigger_en: Liquid glass, cinematic/looping motion or experimental effects appear in a task
rules.trigger_zh: 任务涉及液态玻璃、电影化循环动效或实验效果
rules.require_en: Use such effects only when explicitly requested or clearly inherited from an approved product brief; test fallback and accessibility.
rules.require_zh: 仅在用户明确要求或已批准设计方案明确继承时采用，并验证降级与可访问性。
rules.exception_en: When authorized, a marketing illustration may be deliberately expressive; a dense workbench may remain static and compact.
rules.exception_zh: 营销插画可以经授权采用强动效；高频操作工作台可以保持静态与紧凑。
rules.never_en: Never make a demo effect or aesthetic preset a global default for all pages.
rules.never_zh: 不得把演示特效或配色预设强加为全站通用样式。

rules.topic: Page-header H0 / 页头文字 H0
rules.trigger_en: Creating, editing or reviewing a page title, including legacy content
rules.trigger_zh: 创建、修改或审查页头标题，包括已有历史内容
rules.require_en: Inspect pre-H1 copy; remove or move redundant explanation on task pages; preserve real breadcrumbs, status and approved branding.
rules.require_zh: 检查 H1 前文案；任务页移除或移位重复说明，保留真实面包屑、状态及已确认品牌内容。
rules.exception_en: Meaningful chapter labels and intentional brand/marketing narratives may remain when justified.
rules.exception_zh: 确有意义的章节标识及有依据的品牌/营销叙事可以保留。
rules.never_en: Never retain meaningless old eyebrow text merely because it already exists.
rules.never_zh: 不得仅因原页面已有装饰性眉题就保留无意义文案。

rules.topic: Surface accent S0 / 卡片贴边彩条 S0
rules.trigger_zh: 新建或审查 Card、Panel、Section 容器
rules.require_en: Remove decorative thick colored strips attached to rounded card borders on both new and affected legacy views.
rules.require_zh: 新建及涉及的既有页面都应去除贴着卡片圆角边框的装饰性粗彩条。
rules.exception_en: Actual focus indicators, chart series, progress and status semantics remain valid; a needed outside marker must have a visible gap.
rules.exception_zh: 真实焦点、图表系列、进度与状态语义不受禁令影响；必要外置标记须与容器留明显间隔。
rules.never_en: Never reintroduce a flush colored border, inset shadow or pseudo-element as a decorative card stripe.
rules.never_zh: 不得用彩色单侧边框、内阴影或伪元素重新制造贴边装饰条。

rules.topic: Figma authority / Figma 输入权限
rules.trigger_en: A user asks to implement an existing Figma design
rules.trigger_zh: 用户要求忠实实现现有 Figma 设计
rules.require_en: Identify exact design file, frame/node, authorized source assets, design context and screenshot when available; compare real implementation at the same viewport.
rules.require_zh: 在有条件时锁定准确文件、画板节点、授权资产与设计上下文/截图，并以相同视口对照真实实现。
rules.exception_en: Desktop current-selection is available only with a compatible desktop connection; remote providers may require explicit Figma file and node URL. Screenshot-only work is approximate.
rules.exception_zh: 当前选中节点仅在兼容桌面连接可用；远端提供方可能需要明确文件与节点 URL。只有截图时只能做视觉近似。
rules.never_en: Never fabricate Figma tool access, unprovided asset details or unconditional pixel-perfect parity.
rules.never_zh: 不得虚构 Figma 工具权限、不可见的资产细节或无条件宣称像素级一致。

rules.topic: Scope of viewport / 支持视口范围
rules.trigger_zh: 执行响应式或视口验收
rules.require_en: Test the supported product breakpoints, declared minimum viewport, content reachability and relevant text zoom.
rules.require_zh: 检查产品实际支持的断点、最小视口、内容可达性及相关文字缩放。
rules.exception_en: Only test a 390px mobile layout when mobile support is in scope; desktop-only products still need their smallest supported desktop view.
rules.exception_zh: 只有产品支持移动端时才要求 390px 手机布局；纯桌面产品仍须验收支持的最小桌面尺寸。
rules.never_en: Never add mobile support or force a mobile-first redesign without a product requirement.
rules.never_zh: 不得在无需求时强迫纯桌面项目适配手机或改成移动优先。

rules.trigger_en: Claiming any test, visual or business result
rules.trigger_zh: 汇报任意测试、视觉或业务完成结果
rules.require_en: Specify actual route, state, viewport, data and evidence; use VERIFIED only for the tested scope.
rules.require_zh: 记录实际测试路由、状态、视口、数据与证据；VERIFIED 仅覆盖明确实测范围。
rules.exception_en: Static code analysis is STATIC CHECK; synthetic fixtures are DEMO ONLY; missing conditions are NOT TESTED or BLOCKED.
rules.exception_zh: 仅源码审查标记 STATIC CHECK，合成用例标记 DEMO ONLY，条件不足标记 NOT TESTED 或 BLOCKED。
rules.never_en: Never infer backend persistence from screenshots or smooth animation from a heuristic trace.
rules.never_zh: 不得用截图推断后端真实保存，也不得用启发式帧检测证明动画丝滑。

rules.topic: Review vs implement / 评审与实施区分
rules.trigger_en: Review-only, bug-fix, redesign or general polish request
rules.trigger_zh: 仅评审、修复缺陷、重设计或整体精修请求
rules.require_en: Review-only means findings without edits; a scoped fix requires actual regression checks; major redesign requires confirming design direction before implementation and broader QA.
rules.require_zh: 仅评审输出问题与证据而不改代码；局部修复需要回归测试；重大重设计应先确认方向并做充分复验。
rules.exception_en: Independent formal design critique is valuable for substantial visual change but not mandatory for a one-line bug fix.
rules.exception_zh: 重大视觉改动适合独立审美评审，但单行 Bug 修复不必召开完整设计评审。
rules.never_en: Never turn a review request into source edits or a tiny fix into an unrequested interview.
rules.never_zh: 不得把仅评审请求当成改代码授权，也不得把小修复扩成多轮无关访谈。

rules.topic: Design drift meaning / 设计漂移含义
rules.trigger_en: An observed token, schema or design-document drift is reported
rules.trigger_zh: 发现 Token、文件格式或设计文档漂移
rules.require_en: Distinguish tool version drift, schema drift and product truth drift; code-derived token snapshots are observations, not approved design decisions.
rules.require_zh: 区分工具版本、文档格式和设计事实漂移；从代码提取的 Token 观测快照不是已批准设计决策。
rules.exception_en: With explicit approval, schema changes may be migrated mechanically; truth drift requires checking real product intent and rendered evidence.
rules.exception_zh: 格式变迁可以在获授权后机械迁移；设计事实漂移必须结合产品意图和真实渲染证据判断。
rules.never_en: Never silently overwrite MASTER or brand decisions to make drift checks green.
rules.never_zh: 不得为让漂移检查通过而静默覆盖 MASTER 或用户品牌选择。

rules.topic: Reference research and assets / 参考研究与素材边界
rules.trigger_en: Analyzing external websites, adopting upstream rules or borrowing visual assets
rules.trigger_zh: 分析外部网站、借鉴上游规则或使用视觉素材
rules.require_en: Only access authorized sources; distinguish measured WHAT from inferred WHY and check licensing for copied materials.
rules.require_zh: 仅访问获授权来源，区分实测 WHAT 与推断 WHY，复用素材时核对许可证。
rules.exception_en: If browsing is blocked or a style query yields no domain-relevant result, refine with available evidence or report missing evidence.
rules.exception_zh: 浏览受限或样式搜索没有领域相关结果时，应缩小检索或说明证据不足。
rules.never_en: Never infer source-site designer intent, invent design data or copy protected assets.
rules.never_zh: 不得虚构参考网站的设计意图、伪造设计数据或复制受保护素材。

rules.topic: Browser reconnaissance / 浏览器先观察后操作
rules.trigger_en: Opening a running application for browser tests
rules.trigger_zh: 打开运行中的应用进行浏览器测试
rules.require_en: Inspect live DOM and current page state before choosing selectors; capture browser console and relevant network errors, then interact and retest.
rules.require_zh: 先观察实时 DOM 和页面状态再确定选择器，记录 Console 与相关网络错误，再执行交互和复验。
rules.exception_en: When the browser, app server or permissions are unavailable, report NOT TESTED/BLOCKED without manufacturing selectors or expected results.
rules.exception_zh: 无法访问浏览器、服务或缺少权限时标记 NOT TESTED/BLOCKED，不得编造选择器或测试结果。
rules.never_en: Never substitute a synthetic in-memory demo for actual server-backed workflow verification.
rules.never_zh: 不得用合成内存模拟页面替代真实后端业务链路的验收。

rules.topic: RTL and locale / RTL 与本地化
rules.trigger_en: Product includes RTL languages, locale-sensitive inputs or internationalized content
rules.trigger_zh: 产品包含 RTL 语言、本地化表单或国际化内容
rules.require_en: Use locale-aware date/number formatting and meaningful CJK/RTL text tests, including logical properties when RTL is supported.
rules.require_zh: 使用符合语言环境的日期和数字格式，真实检查中日韩文本和已支持的 RTL 布局，必要时使用逻辑方向 CSS 属性。
rules.exception_en: RTL is conditional on actual supported locales; do not add a new RTL feature to a locale-limited desktop app.
rules.exception_zh: RTL 仅在产品支持对应语言时适用，不要求只支持有限语言的桌面项目新增 RTL。
rules.never_en: Never infer locale from user IP or block ordinary paste without a security reason.
rules.never_zh: 不得仅凭 IP 推断语言，也不得无安全理由禁止用户正常粘贴。
